# ankra_projects (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's projects the token's user can reach, the default project included. Fails while projects are not enabled for the organisation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_projects" "all" {}

output "project_ids_by_slug" {
  value = { for project in data.ankra_projects.all.projects : project.slug => project.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `projects` (Attributes List) Projects of the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created.
- `description` (String) Description; empty when none is set.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default project.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Slug, which never changes.
